keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Taha Habroune (Columbus Crew).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Inter Miami CF 0, Columbus Crew 1. Gonzalo Tapia (Columbus Crew) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Gonzalo Luján (Inter Miami CF) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
